name: Ollie
summary: アーケードゲーム Ollie's Crash Course の主人公
> Ollie is the titular character of Ollie's Crash Course, an arcade game located within Höllvania Central Mall. He is heard responding to Arthur during 1999.
sections: - Ollie is played by James Conlin, who made his voice acting debut with Warframe via the Make-A-Wish program. James was present at TennoCon 2024 and was able to hear his voice alongside his fellow Tenno.
